title: A website guest can cancel or reschedule from their own confirmation email

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21 in code: rescheduleBooking and cancelBooking both require a signed-in member who is the booker (or an admin), and a guest row has no profile, so only the owner can move or cancel a guest booking. The guest's emails link to the website's Book page, which offers neither. Every Calendly invitee gets Cancel and Reschedule links. Fix: a per-booking manage token (the SCAN-834 confirm-token pattern, POST-only so a mail scanner cannot act), a small manage page on the site, and the same notice window the member path uses.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
